scenes.title: Tally × Agora
scenes.sub: Best Cross-Border Payments App on Monad
scenes.vo: Tally, for the Agora cross-border payments bounty.

scenes.title:
Pune to Toronto.
Days and 6% today.
scenes.sub: Riya studies in Toronto. Her parents send lunch money from Pune.
scenes.vo: Riya studies in Toronto. Her parents in Pune send her lunch money, and today that takes days and loses about six percent.

scenes.title:
Two phones.
Two Face IDs.
scenes.sub: Mera derives each account from a passkey. No seed phrase, no extension, no gas.
scenes.vo: Both of them onboard with a passkey. Mom on her phone in Pune, Riya on hers in Toronto. Mera turns each Face ID into an account. No seed phrase, no extension, and no gas to buy.

scenes.title:
Riya's allowance,
in AUSD.
scenes.sub: A dollar stablecoin, held by the Tally contract under her rules.
scenes.vo: Riya's allowance is held in A U S D, a dollar stablecoin, inside the Tally contract, and it can only be spent the way her rules allow.

scenes.title:
Mom sends $20.
With a purpose.
scenes.sub: One link · fingerprint · “For lunches this week” · fee $0.00
scenes.vo: Mom opens Riya's link. She sees exactly what the money can be spent on, picks twenty dollars, adds a note, for lunches this week, and confirms with her fingerprint.

scenes.title:
Arrived.
In about a second.
scenes.sub: Riya's balance goes up, with Mom's note attached.
scenes.vo: On Riya's phone the money is already there, with Mom's note attached. Settled on Monad in about a second, with no transfer fee.

scenes.title: The real transaction.
scenes.sub: Funded(id, from, 20 AUSD, "For lunches this week")
scenes.vo: Here is that exact transaction on the Monad explorer, with the amount and the note in its Funded event.

scenes.title:
Decoded and
balances checked.
scenes.sub: cast receipt · decoded event · AUSD balance before and after
scenes.vo: From the terminal: the receipt succeeded, the event decodes to twenty dollars with the note, and the allowance balance rose by exactly twenty.

scenes.title: Mainnet-ready.
scenes.sub: Testnet uses a 6-decimal AUSD stand-in; mainnet AUSD 0x00000000eFE3…012a is a constructor argument.
scenes.vo: On testnet we use a six decimal stand-in, because A U S D is deployed on mainnet only. Pointing Tally at real A U S D is one constructor argument.

scenes.title: Tally controls the item.
scenes.vo: Tally. Send money home, with a purpose.
